app.name: CleanTV
app.promise: Make your TV fast again, without ads — and restore everything whenever you need.
language.label: Language
demo.label: Demo
flow.label: Your progress
start.title: A fresh start for your TV
start.missingTitle: The TV connection tool is missing
start.missingBody: Connect to the internet and open CleanTV.cmd again. It downloads the official Android platform-tools automatically. Advanced users can set CLEANTV_ADB to the adb executable.
setup.title: Prepare your TV
setup.intro: Keep your TV remote nearby. Choose your TV brand and follow these steps.
setup.debugNote: Some TVs only show USB debugging. Keep it turned on while connecting over Wi-Fi.
connect.title: Connect to your TV
connect.intro: Make sure your TV is switched on and connected to the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
connect.tips: Check that your TV is on, both devices are on the same Wi-Fi, and debugging is turned on. You can also enter the TV’s IP address manually.
connect.manualHint: Find it in your TV’s network settings.
connect.authorizeTitle: Allow this computer on your TV
connect.authorizeBody: Look at the TV screen. Use your remote to select “Always allow from this computer”, then “Allow”.
connect.mockLabel: Example of the permission dialog on your TV
connect.waiting: Waiting for permission on the TV…
connect.authorizeHint: Choose the highlighted options on your TV, not on this computer.
connect.authorizeTimeout: Permission was not received within two minutes. Check the TV screen, then try again.
choose.title: Choose what to turn off
choose.intro: Safe apps are selected for you. Read the effects before choosing any optional apps.
choose.absent: Show apps that are not installed
choose.empty: No apps in this group are installed.
apps.protectedDefault: This app helps your TV keep working.
confirm.title: Ready to clean?
confirm.body: We will turn off {n} apps. Nothing is deleted. You can restore everything with one click.
restore.title: Restore all apps?
restore.body: We will turn back on the apps CleanTV turned off and any disabled apps in the supported list.
progress.title: Cleaning your TV
progress.label: Apps processed
done.title: Your TV is ready
done.tip: Restart your TV for the full effect.
history.title: Activity history
error.ADB_NOT_FOUND: The TV connection tool is missing. Follow the setup instructions on the start screen.
error.INVALID_INPUT: Check the IP address or your app selection, then try again.
error.NOT_FOUND: That page or activity could not be found. Return to the app list and try again.
error.DEVICE_UNREACHABLE: We could not reach your TV. Check its Wi-Fi connection and that it is switched on.
error.DEVICE_UNAUTHORIZED: Allow this computer on your TV screen before continuing.
error.DEVICE_OFFLINE: Your TV is offline. Switch it on and check the Wi-Fi connection.
error.DEVICE_BUSY: Your TV is still working on another action. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
error.PACKAGE_PROTECTED: This app is protected to keep your TV working.
error.PACKAGE_NOT_IN_REGISTRY: This app is not in the supported list, so CleanTV will leave it alone.
error.PACKAGE_IS_LAUNCHER: This is your TV’s current home screen. CleanTV keeps it protected.
error.COMMAND_FAILED: The TV could not complete this action. Check the TV connection and try again.
error.TIMEOUT: The TV took too long to respond. Check the connection and try again.
error.FORBIDDEN: Your session could not be verified. Reload this page and try again.
error.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Try again. If it continues, restart CleanTV.
confirm.body.one: We will turn off {n} app. Nothing is deleted. You can restore everything with one click.
error.JOB_CONNECTION_LOST: CleanTV lost the progress connection. The TV may still be working; check the app list again before starting another action.
error.I18N_UNAVAILABLE: CleanTV could not load its language files. Reload this page. / CleanTV tidak dapat memuatkan fail bahasa. Muat semula halaman ini.
launcher.title: Remove home-screen ads (advanced)
launcher.intro: Choose a launcher for your TV's home screen. CleanTV turns off the original home apps only after checking that your choice is installed, enabled and available as a home app. You can bring the original home screen back at any time.
launcher.name: Projectivy Launcher
launcher.openStore: Open Play Store on the TV
launcher.install: On the TV, install {name} and open it once. Then return here.
launcher.ready: {name} is ready. You can switch your home screen.
launcher.unknown: Check again to see whether your chosen launcher is ready.
launcher.notInstalled: {name} is not installed yet. Follow the steps above on your TV.
launcher.notEnabled: {name} is turned off. Enable it in your TV's app settings, then check again.
launcher.notCandidate: {name} is not available as a home app yet. Open it on the TV, then check again.
launcher.storeOpened: The store request was sent to the TV. Finish the installation there, open {name} once, then choose “Check again”.
launcher.confirm.title: Switch to {name}?
launcher.confirm.body: CleanTV will turn off the original home apps and check that the Home button opens {name}. If the check fails, CleanTV will turn those apps back on automatically. To undo the switch later, choose “Restore the original home screen” or “Restore all”. Keep the TV connected until this finishes.
launcher.restoreConfirm.title: Restore the original home screen?
launcher.restoreConfirm.body: CleanTV will turn on the installed original home apps and check that your Home button opens an original home screen. Replacement launchers stay installed.
launcher.restoredTitle: Your original home screen is back
launcher.failedTitle: The home-screen change could not be completed
launcher.doneTip: Press Home on your TV remote to check the home screen. You can restore the original home screen here at any time.
error.LAUNCHER_NOT_READY: Your chosen launcher is not ready. Install it from Play Store, enable it and open it once on the TV, then check again.
error.LAUNCHER_UNSUPPORTED: Launcher switching is unavailable on Fire OS, CVTE-board TVs and Xiaomi TVs with a China-market or unverified home system. You can still use CleanTV's app cleanup.
error.LAUNCHER_SWAP_ROLLED_BACK: The switch failed. CleanTV turned the affected original home apps back on and verified that a home screen is available.
error.LAUNCHER_ROLLBACK_FAILED: The switch failed and CleanTV could not verify recovery. Keep the TV connected and choose “Restore the original home screen” to try restoring it.
error.LAUNCHER_RESTORE_FAILED: CleanTV could not verify that the original home screen is back. Keep the TV connected and try restoring it again.
error.LAUNCHER_STOCK_MISSING: CleanTV could not find the original home app on this TV. Choose “Restore all”, or contact support if the Home button still does not work.
launcher.recovered: CleanTV restored the original home apps after an interrupted or unsafe home-screen change.
launcher.journalWarning: CleanTV could not save some recovery history. Check the results below.
launcher.manualHome: Press Home on your remote, choose {stock}, select Always, then choose Check again
